newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sansui Electric buoyed by profit seekers.
newsitem.headline: Sansui Electric buoyed by profit seekers.

text.p: Shares of Sansui Electric Co Ltd rose in heavy trading on Tuesday morning, prompted by buying aimed at taking short-term profits, traders said.
The share price climbed 11 yen to 303 yen by 0051 GMT. Its volume was 4.024 million shares, topping the list of most heavily traded issues in the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Sansui's share price recovered the 300 yen level and the prospect that it could rise further prompted buying aimed at short-term profits," a trader with a medium-sized securities house said.
